questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part which has an error: The captain, along with his officers, were commended for their bravery during the naval exercise.
options: The captain, along with his officers,
questions.explanation: When a singular subject is followed by 'along with', the verb agrees with the main subject. 'Captain' is singular, so 'was' is correct.
